$comment: MCP config for role evals (item 7.1). Only the evor server.
The full .mcp.json also starts semantic-scholar, arxiv and hf-mcp. Those are
network-bound, rate-limited and irrelevant to what a tier eval measures — a
flaky third-party server would show up as a model failure, which is the
confound class this whole phase exists to remove.
Every evor_* tool is what the roles are graded on calling.
Absolute path: --mcp-config resolves the command relative to the CLI's cwd, not to the config file, and a relative path silently produced a session with NO evor tools that still reported turns.
